page.overview:
Who is Shrivel Braittrand?

Shrivel Braittrand, a Kulless from Gerres Gule, moved from his home planet to seek employment as a race mechanic. He was hired by Boles Roor, glimmik singer and two-time winner of the Boonta Eve Classic. After Roor's loss in the Boonta race, he quit Podracing and gave his pod to Braittrand, who modified it into the Kulless Squall and embarked on a quite successful racing career. He was one of the few Podracing pilots not to meet his end during a race.

Shrivel Braittrand first appeared as a playable character in the 2002 Rainbow Studios video game Star Wars: Racer Revenge. In the "tournament" game mode, the player can choose to play as Braittrand and win the Galactic Trials, Podracing Open, and Hutt Championships tournaments. After winning the Hutt Championships, the Kulless is invited to the palace of the Hutt crime lord Jabba Desilijic Tiure to receive his trophy in the Hutt's throne room.

Braittrand also appears in another ending for the tournament game mode, if the player wins it as Teemto Pagalies. After Pagalies is presented his trophy, Briattrand throws an object at the Veknoid's face, drawing the attention of him and the crowd. Gamorrean guards then come to remove the Kulless from the throne room.

Star Wars: Racer Revenge: Prima's Official Strategy Guide
